recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missed short-text part of FHIR-16465 while leaving the already-applied definition, introduction, and later FHIR-18613 comment intact.
issue_request: FHIR-16465 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core CodeSystem. It objected that CodeSystem.versionNeeded.short said 'If definitions are not stable' without explaining which definitions, and requested concept-permanence wording based on the element definition.
initial_application: The issue was recorded as done under another task. FHIR-16734 changed the versionNeeded definition to 'does not commit to concept permanence across versions' in 05faea9160, and FHIR-14243 changed the CodeSystem introduction to mention concept permanence. The later R4B source conversion carried forward the old short text unchanged into structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml.
additional_context: CodeSystem is active in source/fhir.ini, and the authoritative source is source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml. FHIR-18613 later declined renaming versionNeeded to conceptPermanence but added comment text about display validation, already present in current source, so the reconciliation should preserve the element and only update the stale short.
reconciliation: Changed CodeSystem.versionNeeded.short from 'If definitions are not stable' to 'Code system does not commit to concept permanence across versions'. No generated diagram or external-repo changes were needed.
